name: pressure-critical-hover
description: WARM-WORLD RE-DERIVATION 2026-09-07 (run pressure-critical-hover-3d0e998-20260907-200026): on the warm 10-room world the bot's own cost is ~75 cpu/tick (not the fresh-colony 18), so the original 220/96 ms schedule drove cpu to 250 and the bucket from 9500 to 10 in ~55 ticks (three VM kills, one corrupt-segment world reset — finding F11); the shipped 220/96 schedule below is the FRESH-COLONY calibration pinned by report.rs; for a warm world subtract (own - 18) from every ms (warm 10-room world: ramp ~65 ms, hover ~30 ms) after measuring own cost with report --run. ORIGINAL: ADR 0004 governor calibration rung (b): drive the bucket under CRITICAL_BUCKET=1500 and HOVER there for two BUCKET_WINDOWs (200 ticks) without pinning at 0, then release. MODEL (private server): per-user limit L=100 cpu/tick; refill per tick = L - used, cap 10000, floor 0 (at 0 the engine caps the tick at L and a non-sheddable burner kills every tick = artefact, never a governor finding). EVIDENCE (runs/pressure-bbe86e0-20260611-060159, builtin_pressure ms=90, fresh colony own cost ~18 ms): onset drain ~10/tick (10000->9866 over 14 ticks; seg-57 cpu.used 108-110 = 18+90, i.e. 100-108), then a 200-tick PLATEAU at ~8990 with cpu.used mostly ~90.7 -> the sustained net drain at ms=90 was ~0, so the empirical break-even burn is BE~90 ms (the onset-vs-plateau discrepancy is open; the first run's bucket slope settles it). Net drain d(ms) ~ ms - BE per tick while burning; refill ~ L - own ~ 82/tick when off (DrainModel::PRIVATE_FRESH in src/report.rs; the pin test replays this schedule through it). STAGE 1 (ramp, observed 300..361 inclusive): ms=220 -> d~130/tick x 62 ticks = 8060 -> bucket ~1940 after tick 361; Critical-by-TREND fires as soon as bucket<4000 (~tick 46 of the ramp) because the 100-tick least-squares slope is far below CRITICAL_DRAIN=-10. Tick 362 is burn-free (+82 -> ~2022). STAGE 2 (hover, observed 363..562, scheduled ON one tick AFTER stage-1 OFF so the injections fire in vector order): ms=96 -> d~6/tick x 200 ticks = 1200 -> ~2022 -> ~820; crosses CRITICAL_BUCKET at ~hover tick 87 (observed ~450) and stays in the 300..1500 band (Critical by LEVEL) for the remaining ~113 ticks. TAIL (563..900, 337 ticks > 3 windows): refill ~82/tick -> 1500 at +8, 4000 at +39 (Conserve by level), 10000 at +112; tier ladder Critical -> Conserve -> Normal. ERROR BUDGET: injections fire on 2 s sampler ticks (<= ~8 ticks lag per injection under a 220 ms burn, ~20 at 100 ms) -> ramp duration +-8 ticks = +-1040 bucket; BE +-5 ms -> ramp +-310, hover +-1000 over 200 ticks. RETUNE RULES (one JSON edit each, from `screeps-ibex-eval report --run <dir>`): hover slope s (bucket/tick, negative) -> hover ms += (-6 - s); ramp end off by D from ~1940 -> ramp duration += D/130 ticks; any bucket=0 sample -> shorten the ramp first. WARM-WORLD CAVEAT (D8): derived for own cost ~18 ms; if the pre-burn mean cpu.used is U, subtract (U-18) from every ms.
